hooks.command: P=""; for C in "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)/.." "/Users/bilibili/personal/note"; do if [ -n "$C" ] && [ -f "$C/.Codex/hooks/prettier_guard.py" ]; then P="$C/.Codex/hooks/prettier_guard.py"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$P" ]; then exec python3 "$P"; fi; exit 0
